topic: Calling the Airline about Credit after a Missed Flight

script.title: THE CREDIT CALL
script.scene_zh: 機場服務櫃台 · 撥信用專線
script.story_hook: One wrong connection, one phone call to fix it.
script.intro_zh: 錯過一班轉機，一通電話就能收拾局面。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today we ride along on an airline call. Listen for polite openers and money words.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天跟著聽一通航空公司的電話。留意禮貌的開場與金錢相關說法。
script.outro: That's how a missed flight turns into credit. Listen once more, then say it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 錯過的航班就這樣換成了機票信用。再聽一遍，然後大聲說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: I'd love my money to work again
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her late twenties with straight black hair in a low ponytail, round wire glasses, an olive green puffer jacket over a cream sweater, a crossbody bag, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man in his forties with short greying hair, rimless glasses, a light blue collared shirt with a dark navy lanyard, a salt-and-pepper mustache, and a broad-shouldered sturdy build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry to bother you, it's about a missed flight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi tə ˈbɑɹəɹ ju ɪts əˈbaʊt ə mɪst flaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思打擾，我要問錯過班機的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No bother at all, those calls come in daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈbɑɹəɹ æt ɔl ðoʊz kɔlz kʌm ɪn ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 一點也不打擾，我們天天都接到這種電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: June Alcaraz, confirmation R, K, seven, two, Q.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒun ˈælkəˌræz ˌkɑnfɚˈmeɪʃən ɑɹ keɪ ˈsɛvən tu kju/
dialogue.zh: 我叫 June Alcaraz，訂位代號是 R、K、七、二、Q。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, June, one second, pulling up the booking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt dʒun wʌn ˈsɛkənd ˈpʊlɪŋ ʌp ðə ˈbʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 查到了，June，稍等我調出訂單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, the hold music was honestly pretty good.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔɹ taɪm ðə hoʊld ˈmjuzɪk wəz ˈɑnəstli ˈpɹɪti ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 不急，說實話剛才的等候音樂還挺好聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, nobody's ever complimented that playlist before.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnɑbədis ˈɛvɚ ˈkɑmpləˌmɛntɪd ðæt ˈpleɪˌlɪst bɪˈfɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那份播放清單從來沒人誇過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, can you see my trip to Boston?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kən ju si maɪ trɪp tə ˈbɑstən/
dialogue.zh: 所以你看得到我飛波士頓那段行程嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do, Austin to Boston, last Tuesday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ˈɔstɪn tə ˈbɑstən læst ˈtuzdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 看得到，奧斯汀飛波士頓，上週二早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, um, the first leg left thirty minutes late.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌm ði fɝst lɛɡ lɛft ˈθɜɹti ˈmɪnəts leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，嗯，第一程出發晚了半個鐘頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the gate closed while you were running.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ðə ɡeɪt kloʊzd waɪl ju wɚ ˈɹʌnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 是呀，您奔跑趕路的當口，登機口剛好關上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred meters... but the agent waved me off.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈhʌndɹəd ˈmitɚz bət ði ˈeɪdʒənt weɪvd mi ˈɔf/
dialogue.zh: 只剩兩百公尺，但地勤揮手讓我別衝過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ouch, that wave hurts even over the phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊtʃ ðæt weɪv hɚts ˈivən ˈoʊvɚ ðə foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 哎喲，那一下揮手，光是聽電話都覺得痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, um, was that my fault or yours?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʌm wəz ðæt maɪ fɔlt ɔɹ jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 所以，嗯，那到底算誰的錯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good question, and here it counts as involuntary.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈkwɛstʃən ænd hɪɹ ɪt kaʊnts æz ˌɪnvoʊlˈtɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 問得好，這情況算非自願誤機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Involuntary? What does that word change, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɪnvoʊlˈtɛɹəɹi wət dʌz ðæt wɜd tʃeɪnd ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 非自願？這個詞到底會改變什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If you skip it, that's voluntary, you pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ju skɪp ɪt ðæts ˈvɑlənˌtɛɹi ju peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 您自己沒趕上，那就算自願，費用得自己吸收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if the airline was late, that's ours, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ði ˈɛɹlaɪn wəz leɪt ðæts aʊɹz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 如果是航空公司延誤，那就是你們的責任，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Our delay means the fee comes off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli aʊɹ dɪˈleɪ minz ðə fi kʌmz ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 一點沒錯。延誤在我們這邊，手續費就免掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, so the rebooking fee is gone?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt soʊ ðə ˌɹiˈbʊkɪŋ fi ɪz ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 等等，也就是改簽的費用不用收了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waived, one hundred ten dollars back to zero.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪvd wʌn ˈhʌndɹəd tɛn ˈdɑlərz bæk tə ˈzɪɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 全免，一百一十塊直接歸零。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, big relief, honestly my chest just loosened up.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ bɪɡ rɪˈlif ˈɑnəstli maɪ tʃɛst dʒʌst ˈlusənd ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 好，瞬間鬆一口氣，說實話我的心這才放下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your money stays with us, nothing is lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈmʌni steɪz wɪð ʌs ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz lɔst/
dialogue.zh: 您的錢仍留在我們這裡，一分都不會不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, um, what happens to that ticket money?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ʌm wət ˈhæpənz tə ðæt ˈtɪkət ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 那，嗯，我原本那張票的錢到底會怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It becomes travel credit, still your money, just stored.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt bɪˈkʌmz ˈtɹævəl ˈkɹɛdɪt stɪl jʊɹ ˈmʌni dʒʌst stɔɹd/
dialogue.zh: 它會變成機票信用，錢仍是您的，只是先存起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stored where? Do I get a card or a code?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɔɹd wɛɹ du aɪ ɡɛt ə kɑɹd ɔɹ ə koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 存在哪裡？會給我卡還是代碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A code in your account, it covers flights and upgrades.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə koʊd ɪn jɔɹ əˈkaʊnt ɪt ˈkʌvɚz flaɪts ænd ˈʌpˌɡɹeɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 一組存在您帳戶裡的代碼，買機票、升艙都能折抵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, I'd love my money to work again.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs aɪd lʌv maɪ ˈmʌni tə wɜk əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我希望我的錢能重新派上用場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will, you have a full year to spend it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl ju hæv ə fʊl jɪɹ tə spɛnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會派上用場的，您有整整一年可以運用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A year? I plan things very slowly, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə jɪɹ aɪ plæn θɪŋz ˈvɛɹi ˈsloʊli ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 一年啊？說實話，我規劃事情向來很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the original travel date, one full year.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹəm ði əˈɹɪdʒənəl ˈtɹævəl deɪt wʌn fʊl jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 從原定出發日算起，整整一年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, um, since I flew Tuesday, when does it end?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʌm sɪns aɪ flu ˈtuzdeɪ wən dʌz ɪt ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 那，嗯，我是週二搭的機，哪天會失效？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same weekday next year, around September the twentieth.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈwikdeɪ nɛkst jɪɹ əˈɹaʊnd səpˈtɛmbɚ ðə ˈtwɛntiəθ/
dialogue.zh: 明年同一個星期幾，大概九月二十號前後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, can I extend it if life gets busy?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm kən aɪ ɪkˈstɛnd ɪt ɪf laɪf ɡɛts ˈbizi/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，之後要是太忙，能辦理延期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once, six extra months, for a small fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns sɪks ˈɛkstrə mʌnθs fɔɹ ə smɔl fi/
dialogue.zh: 可以延期一次，多加六個月，收一點手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough, better than losing the whole balance.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf ˈbɛɾɚ ðən ˈluzɪŋ ðə hoʊl ˈbæləns/
dialogue.zh: 合理，總比餘額全部歸零好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any unused part also stays in the wallet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ʌnˈjuzd pɑɹt ˈɔlsoʊ steɪz ɪn ðə ˈwɑlət/
dialogue.zh: 沒用完的部分也會繼續留在錢包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my husband use my credit someday?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən maɪ ˈhʌzbənd juz maɪ ˈkɹɛdɪt ˈsʌmˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有一天可以讓我先生使用我的機票信用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not directly, it's tied to your name.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt dəˈɹɛktli ɪts taɪd tə jɔɹ neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 不能直接用，它綁在您的名字上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But he takes way more trips than me.
dialogue.phonetic: /bət hi teɪks weɪ mɔɹ trɪps ðæn mi/
dialogue.zh: 可是他出門次數比我多太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may book a flight for him with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪ bʊk ə flaɪt fɚ hɪm wɪð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不過您可以用它幫他訂機票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that works, he flies weekly for work.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt wɜks hi flaɪz ˈwikli fɚ wɜk/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這招可行，他每週都因工作搭機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, then nothing from that delay goes to waste.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɛn ˈnʌθɪŋ fɹəm ðæt dɪˈleɪ goʊz tə weɪst/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那樣延誤就沒有讓任何錢白花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, um, what about my ruined night?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ʌm wət əˈbaʊt maɪ ɹuˈɪnd naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，嗯，延誤毀掉的那一晚該怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Overnight? Well, we owe you a hotel voucher.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊvɚˈnaɪt wɛl wi oʊ ju ə hoʊˈtɛl ˈvaʊtʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 過夜嗎？嗯，我們欠您一張飯店折價券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A real free hotel? Tell me I'm dreaming here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɹiəl fri hoʊˈtɛl tɛl mi aɪm ˈdɹimɪŋ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 真的有免費住的飯店？告訴我這不是做夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You waited politely on hold, that's currency here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈweɪtɪd pəˈlɑɪtli ɑn hoʊd ðæts ˈkɜɹənsi hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 您客客氣氣聽完那整段等候音樂，在我們這裡就是貨幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Which hotels does it cover?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wɪtʃ hoʊˈtɛlz dʌz ɪt ˈkʌvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！那它能在哪些飯店用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two airport hotels, both shuttle you in five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈɛɹˌpɔɹt hoʊˈtɛlz boʊθ ˈʃʌtl ju ɪn faɪv ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 兩間機場飯店，都有接駁車五分鐘直達。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And dinner? Landing late, my stomach was singing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈdɪnɚ ˈlændɪŋ leɪt maɪ ˈstʌmək wəz ˈsɪŋɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那晚餐呢？那麼晚才落地，我餓得肚子一直在唱歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a fifteen dollar meal card, inside the terminal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz ə ˌfɪfˈtin ˈdɑləɹ mil kæɹd ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈtɝmənəl/
dialogue.zh: 還有一張十五美元的餐券，限定航廈內使用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the burger place it is, fine by me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈbɜɹɡɚ pleɪs ɪt ɪz faɪn baɪ mi/
dialogue.zh: 那就吃漢堡店吧，我完全沒意見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app pings you before the credit expires.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp pɪŋz ju bɪˈfɔɹ ðə ˈkɹɛdɪt ɪkˈspaɪɚz/
dialogue.zh: App 會在信用到期前傳通知提醒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To check my credit later, where do I log in?
dialogue.phonetic: /tə tʃɛk maɪ ˈkɹɛdɪt ˈleɪtɚ wɛɹ du aɪ lɑɡ ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 之後要查信用餘額，我該上哪裡看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your account page, wallet section, balance sits right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔɹ əˈkaʊnt peɪdʒ ˈwɑlət ˈsɛkʃən ˈbæləns sɪts ɹaɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 您的帳戶頁面，錢包那一欄，餘額就在最明顯的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, friendly reminders, I might set that to loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ˈfɹɛndli ɹɪˈmaɪndɚz aɪ maɪt sɛt ðæt tə laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這麼貼心的提醒，我想把它調到最大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do. One text now with the voucher details.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz du wʌn tɛkst naʊ wɪð ðə ˈvaʊtʃɚ dɪˈteɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 請務必。我這就傳一則簡訊，裡面有折價券明細。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It buzzed, the voucher arrived, perfect timing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt bʌzd ðə ˈvaʊtʃɚ əˈraɪvd ˈpɝfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 手機剛震了一下，折價券就到了，時間剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And done, Saturday, ten fifteen, window seat saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd dʌn ˈsætɚˌdeɪ tɛn fɪfˈtin ˈwɪndoʊ sit seɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 也辦好了，週六早上十點十五分，靠窗位子留好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You even saved the window, thank you truly!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈivən seɪvd ðə ˈwɪndoʊ θæŋk ju ˈtɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 您連靠窗都幫我留了，真心感謝您！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to help, safe travels, enjoy that burger.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə hɛlp seɪf ˈtɹævəlz ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðæt ˈbɜɹɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 很高興能幫忙，旅途平安，漢堡好好享用。

script.youtube_title: 【誤機別慌✈️】「我希望我的錢能重新派上用場」打給航空公司📞｜改簽費免了・信用一年・飯店餐券🎧｜60句聽力練習｜Missed Flight Credit Call
script.youtube_title_en: "I'd Love My Money to Work Again" - Calling the Airline About Flight Credit
script.youtube_description:
「我希望我的錢能重新派上用場」——轉機沒趕上，那張機票的錢去哪了？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就是一通打給航空公司的信用專線。

你會聽到：怎麼開口說明誤機、報訂位代號；非自願與自願誤機的差別，為什麼改簽費可以免掉；機票信用存在哪裡、一年有效期怎麼算、能否延期、能否給家人訂票；還有過夜飯店折價券與十五美元餐券的實用問法。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現的是美國人打電話的真實語感：um、well、so、hmm、fair enough。聽完你就會用：Sorry to bother you、Can I extend it、It's tied to your name。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

"I'd love my money to work again" — you missed the connection, so where did your ticket money go? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice built around one real phone call to the airline's credit line.

You will hear: how to open the call and read out a confirmation code; the difference between involuntary and voluntary skips, and why the rebooking fee disappears; where travel credit lives, its one-year clock, extensions, booking for family; plus the overnight hotel voucher and the meal card for long waits.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the fillers Americans really use on the phone: um, well, so, hmm, fair enough. By the end you'll own lines like Sorry to bother you, Can I extend it, and It's tied to your name.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

這一集帶大家跟一通打給航空公司信用專線的電話，從報訂位代號、確認非自願誤機、免掉改簽費，一路聽到機票信用的一年有效期、飯店折價券、餐券，最後改妥航班道別，共六十句連續真實對話。
